**IDENTITY:**
  KIND: package body
  PURPOSE: employee lifecycle management (hire, update, transfer, promote, terminate, rehire) and employee/org-chart lookups for the HRMS schema

**STRUCTURES:**
  c_emp_number_prefix — KIND: constant; TYPE: VARCHAR2(3)
  c_max_hierarchy_depth — KIND: constant; TYPE: NUMBER

**METHODS:**
  **FUNCTION generate_emp_number RETURN VARCHAR2** [SOURCE: L40-56]
  - What it does: Called internally (by create_employee) to mint a new employee number. Selects the max numeric suffix from EMP_NUMBER values in EMPLOYEES matching 'EMP-%', adds 1, and formats as prefix + 6-digit zero-padded number. On any exception, falls back to a sequence-based number instead.
  - Business rules: Employee numbers follow format EMP-NNNNNN, derived by incrementing the current max suffix. Comment flags a known bug: race condition under concurrent inserts, since there's no SELECT FOR UPDATE / locking on the MAX lookup, so concurrent calls can generate duplicate numbers [L38].
  - Numbers & thresholds: c_emp_number_prefix = 'EMP' [L7]; v_new_number declared VARCHAR2(20) [L42]; LPAD width of 6 digits with '0' padding used in both the primary and fallback path [L49, L55].
  - Security & error handling: WHEN OTHERS catches any exception (including the race-condition duplicate scenario) and falls back to SEQ_EMPLOYEE.NEXTVAL-based numbering instead of failing [L52-55].
  - Data in/out: Input — none (reads EMPLOYEES internally). Output — returns generated employee number as VARCHAR2.

  **FUNCTION get_next_emp_id RETURN NUMBER** [SOURCE: L61-66]
  - What it does: Private helper (used internally by create_employee) that pulls SEQ_EMPLOYEE.NEXTVAL via SELECT ... FROM DUAL.
  - Business rules: None beyond sequence-based ID assignment.
  - Numbers & thresholds: None.
  - Security & error handling: None — no exception handling.
  - Data in/out: Input — none. Output — returns NUMBER.

  **PROCEDURE validate_dept(p_dept_id IN NUMBER)** [SOURCE: L71-86]
  - What it does: Private helper called by create_employee, transfer_employee, and rehire_employee. Counts DEPARTMENTS rows matching p_dept_id with ACTIVE_FLAG='Y'; raises an error if none found.
  - Business rules: Only departments flagged ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' are valid for employee assignment [L74]. Department must exist and be active before assignment [L81].
  - Numbers & thresholds: None beyond the 'Y' flag literal.
  - Security & error handling: RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20003, ...) when the department is invalid or inactive [L84].
  - Data in/out: Input — p_dept_id. Output — none (validation only; raises on failure).

  **PROCEDURE validate_manager(p_manager_id IN NUMBER, p_emp_id IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)** [SOURCE: L92-142]
  - What it does: Private helper called by create_employee (validate only) and transfer_employee (validate + circular check). If p_manager_id is NULL, returns immediately as valid. Otherwise checks the manager exists in EMPLOYEES with EMPLOYMENT_STATUS='ACTIVE'. If p_emp_id is supplied, walks up the MANAGER_EMP_ID chain from p_manager_id checking for a loop back to p_emp_id, up to c_max_hierarchy_depth levels.
  - Business rules: NULL manager is valid (top-level employee) [L97-99]. Manager must exist and be EMPLOYMENT_STATUS='ACTIVE' [L103-114]. Circular reporting chains are prohibited, checked only when p_emp_id is supplied [L117-141]. Chain walk stops after c_max_hierarchy_depth levels or when NO_DATA_FOUND ends the chain [L134-136].
  - Numbers & thresholds: c_max_hierarchy_depth = 15 (max reporting-hierarchy traversal depth to prevent unbounded loop-detection traversal) [L9, L120].
  - Security & error handling: RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20004, ...) for invalid/inactive manager [L113] and for detected circular chain [L124-126]. Inner NO_DATA_FOUND on the chain walk is caught and treated as end-of-chain rather than an error [L134-136].
  - Data in/out: Input — p_manager_id, p_emp_id (optional). Output — none (validation only; raises on failure).

  **PROCEDURE log_history(p_emp_id, p_change_type, p_effective_date, p_old_dept_id, p_new_dept_id, p_old_job_id, p_new_job_id, p_old_manager, p_new_manager, p_old_salary, p_new_salary, p_old_location, p_new_location, p_reason_code, p_comments, p_user)** [SOURCE: L148-190]
  - What it does: Private helper called by create_employee, transfer_employee, promote_employee, terminate_employee, and rehire_employee after each change. Runs as an autonomous transaction; inserts one row into EMPLOYEE_HISTORY with old/new values and commits independently of the caller's transaction.
  - Business rules: History logging must never fail the calling transaction — any exception is caught, rolled back locally, and swallowed (optionally logged to DBMS_OUTPUT) rather than propagated [L182-189].
  - Numbers & thresholds: None.
  - Security & error handling: PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION isolates the INSERT+COMMIT from the caller's transaction [L166]. WHEN OTHERS rolls back and, only if g_debug_mode is set, prints a warning — otherwise fails silently [L182-189].
  - Data in/out: Inputs — p_emp_id, p_change_type, p_effective_date (required); old/new dept/job/manager/salary/location, reason_code, comments, p_user (optional). Output — inserts one EMPLOYEE_HISTORY row via SEQ_EMP_HISTORY.NEXTVAL; commits.

  **FUNCTION create_employee(p_first_name, p_last_name, p_hire_date, p_dept_id, p_job_id, p_manager_emp_id, p_location_code, p_employment_type, p_base_salary, p_email, p_user) RETURN NUMBER** [SOURCE: L195-361]
  - What it does: Public hire entry point. Validates first/last name are present, validates department and manager, checks the job exists/active and gets its grade, optionally warns (non-blocking) if starting salary is outside the grade's band, defaults location from the department if unset, generates EMP_ID/EMP_NUMBER, inserts the EMPLOYEES row, optionally creates an initial SALARY_RECORDS row via PKG_PAYROLL.create_salary_record, logs history, writes an audit entry, and sends welcome/manager notifications.
  - Business rules: First and last name are mandatory [L214-218]. Department must be valid/active [L220]. Manager, if any, must be valid [L221]. Job must exist and be ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' [L224-233]. Starting salary outside the job grade's MIN_SALARY/MAX_SALARY band is only a soft warning (not enforced here — Forms layer allows override with manager approval) [L246-255]. Location defaults to the department's location when not provided [L260-267]. A SALARY_RECORDS row is only created if a starting salary is explicitly given [L289-300]. Names stored upper-cased/trimmed; email stored lower-cased/trimmed [L281-284]. Manager notification only sent if a manager was assigned [L334-344]. Duplicate employee number (race condition from generate_emp_number) surfaces as a retry-able error [L349-351].
  - Numbers & thresholds: v_emp_number declared VARCHAR2(20) [L209]; default p_employment_type = 'FULL_TIME' [L203]; error codes -20010 (missing name) [L217], -20011 (invalid/inactive job) [L232], -20002 (duplicate employee number) [L351].
  - Security & error handling: RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR -20010/-20011 on validation failure; DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX mapped to -20002 with a retry message [L349-351]; WHEN OTHERS logs via PKG_COMMON.log_error then re-raises [L352-360]. No dynamic SQL; inputs bound as parameters.
  - Data in/out: Inputs — p_first_name, p_last_name, p_hire_date, p_dept_id, p_job_id (required); p_manager_emp_id, p_location_code, p_employment_type (default 'FULL_TIME'), p_base_salary, p_email, p_user (default USER) (optional). Output — returns new EMP_ID; inserts EMPLOYEES, optionally SALARY_RECORDS (via PKG_PAYROLL), EMPLOYEE_HISTORY; writes audit log; sends up to two notifications.

  **PROCEDURE update_employee(p_emp_id, p_first_name, p_last_name, p_email, p_phone_work, p_phone_mobile, p_address_line1, p_address_line2, p_city, p_state_province, p_postal_code, p_country_code, p_user)** [SOURCE: L367-413]
  - What it does: Public partial-update of contact/personal info. Confirms the employee exists, then updates only EMPLOYEES columns for which a non-NULL argument was passed (others preserved via NVL); writes an audit entry.
  - Business rules: Employee must exist before update [L384-387]. NULL parameters preserve existing values (partial-update pattern) [L389]. Names upper-cased/trimmed, email lower-cased/trimmed on write [L391-393]. Zero rows affected after a successful existence check is treated as a concurrent-deletion integrity failure [L406-410].
  - Numbers & thresholds: None.
  - Security & error handling: RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR -20001 if employee not found [L386], and -20001 again if the UPDATE affects 0 rows [L409].
  - Data in/out: Input — p_emp_id (required); contact/address fields, p_user (optional). Output — updates matching EMPLOYEES row; writes PKG_AUDIT log entry.

  **FUNCTION get_employee(p_emp_id IN NUMBER) RETURN t_emp_rec** [SOURCE: L418-445]
  - What it does: Public lookup returning core employee fields plus a correlated subquery for current base salary from SALARY_RECORDS.
  - Business rules: Current salary is the active salary record (ACTIVE_FLAG='Y') effective on/before SYSDATE with END_DATE NULL or in the future [L426-433].
  - Numbers & thresholds: ROWNUM = 1 subquery limiter [L433].
  - Security & error handling: RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR -20001 if EMP_ID not found (NO_DATA_FOUND) [L444].
  - Data in/out: Input — p_emp_id. Output — returns t_emp_rec record.

  **FUNCTION get_employee_by_number(p_emp_number IN VARCHAR2) RETURN t_emp_rec** [SOURCE: L450-464]
  - What it does: Public lookup; resolves EMP_NUMBER to EMP_ID via EMPLOYEES, then delegates to get_employee.
  - Business rules: None beyond delegating to get_employee's rules.
  - Numbers & thresholds: None.
  - Security & error handling: RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR -20001 if EMP_NUMBER not found [L463].
  - Data in/out: Input — p_emp_number. Output — returns t_emp_rec (via get_employee).

  **PROCEDURE search_employees(p_cursor OUT t_emp_cursor, p_last_name, p_first_name, p_dept_id, p_status, p_location_code, p_hire_date_from, p_hire_date_to)** [SOURCE: L472-527]
  - What it does: Public dynamic search. Builds a SQL string joining EMPLOYEES, DEPARTMENTS, JOB_TITLES starting from "WHERE 1=1", appending filter clauses per non-NULL parameter, ordered by last/first name, then opens p_cursor as a REF CURSOR for the built SQL.
  - Business rules: Status filter, when provided, restricts to the given EMPLOYMENT_STATUS value [L505-508]. All filters optional and additive (AND-combined).
  - Numbers & thresholds: v_sql declared VARCHAR2(4000) [L482].
  - Security & error handling: Comment explicitly flags a SQL injection bug — p_last_name, p_first_name, and other string filters are concatenated directly into dynamic SQL instead of using bind variables [L469-470, L493-494, L498, L507, L511], mitigated in practice only by Forms LOV pre-validation, not by this procedure. No other error handling.
  - Data in/out: Inputs — all filter parameters optional. Output — p_cursor (OUT REF CURSOR) opened against the dynamic query.

  **PROCEDURE transfer_employee(p_emp_id, p_new_dept_id, p_new_job_id, p_new_manager_id, p_new_location, p_effective_date, p_reason_code, p_comments, p_user)** [SOURCE: L532-608]
  - What it does: Public department/job/manager/location transfer. Locks the EMPLOYEES row (FOR UPDATE NOWAIT), requires ACTIVE status, validates the new department, defaults job/location to current values if unset, validates the new manager (with circular-chain check) if supplied, updates EMPLOYEES, logs history, writes an audit entry.
  - Business rules: Only ACTIVE employees may be transferred [L553-558]. New department must be valid/active [L561]. Job/location default to current values when not specified [L564-566]. New manager, if given, is validated including circular-chain detection [L569-572].
  - Numbers & thresholds: Error code -20012.
  - Security & error handling: FOR UPDATE NOWAIT (fails immediately rather than blocking if locked) [L551]. RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR -20012 if not ACTIVE [L556-557]. WHEN OTHERS logs via PKG_COMMON.log_error and re-raises [L605-607].
  - Data in/out: Inputs — p_emp_id, p_new_dept_id (required); job/manager/location/effective_date (default SYSDATE)/reason/comments/user (optional). Output — updates EMPLOYEES; inserts EMPLOYEE_HISTORY; writes audit log.

  **PROCEDURE promote_employee(p_emp_id, p_new_job_id, p_new_salary, p_effective_date, p_comments, p_user)** [SOURCE: L613-676]
  - What it does: Public promotion. Reads the employee's current JOB_ID, looks up the most recent active SALARY_RECORDS row (defaulting to 0 if none), updates EMPLOYEES.JOB_ID, creates a new salary record via PKG_PAYROLL.create_salary_record with a computed % change, logs history, writes audit entry.
  - Business rules: Most recent ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' record (EFFECTIVE_DATE DESC, first row) is the % change baseline; absent record defaults to 0 [L629-640]. % change computed only when prior salary > 0, else NULL [L655-658].
  - Numbers & thresholds: Percentage change rounded to 2 decimal places: ROUND(((p_new_salary - v_old_salary) / v_old_salary) * 100, 2) [L657]. ROWNUM = 1 limiter on salary lookup [L635].
  - Security & error handling: NO_DATA_FOUND on salary lookup caught, defaults old salary to 0 [L637-640]. No WHEN OTHERS handler in this procedure.
  - Data in/out: Inputs — p_emp_id, p_new_job_id, p_new_salary (required); effective_date (default SYSDATE), comments, user (optional). Output — updates EMPLOYEES.JOB_ID; inserts SALARY_RECORDS (via PKG_PAYROLL); inserts EMPLOYEE_HISTORY; writes audit log.

  **PROCEDURE terminate_employee(p_emp_id, p_termination_date, p_reason, p_comments, p_user)** [SOURCE: L681-786]
  - What it does: Public termination. Locks the EMPLOYEES row (FOR UPDATE), rejects if already TERMINATED, auto-cancels PENDING leave requests, sets EMPLOYEES to TERMINATED/ACTIVE_FLAG='N' with date/reason, closes the active SALARY_RECORDS row and active EMPLOYEE_PAY_ELEMENTS rows, logs history, writes audit entry, notifies manager if present. Leaves several integrations unimplemented (TODOs).
  - Business rules: Cannot re-terminate an already-TERMINATED employee [L697-701]. All PENDING leave requests auto-cancelled on termination [L704-721]. Only currently active (ACTIVE_FLAG='Y') SALARY_RECORDS and EMPLOYEE_PAY_ELEMENTS rows are closed [L734-751]. Manager notification only sent if a manager is assigned [L766-776]. TODOs (not implemented): COBRA benefits integration, revoking access via PKG_SECURITY, final-pay calc via PKG_PAYROLL.calculate_final_pay [L778-780].
  - Numbers & thresholds: Error code -20005.
  - Security & error handling: FOR UPDATE row lock (blocking) [L694]. RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR -20005 if already terminated [L699-700]. WHEN OTHERS logs via PKG_COMMON.log_error and re-raises [L783-785].
  - Data in/out: Inputs — p_emp_id, p_termination_date, p_reason (required); comments, user (optional). Output — updates EMPLOYEES, LEAVE_REQUESTS (conditionally), SALARY_RECORDS, EMPLOYEE_PAY_ELEMENTS; inserts EMPLOYEE_HISTORY; writes audit log; sends manager notification if applicable.

  **PROCEDURE rehire_employee(p_emp_id, p_rehire_date, p_dept_id, p_job_id, p_base_salary, p_user)** [SOURCE: L791-836]
  - What it does: Public rehire. Validates the new department, resets EMPLOYEES to ACTIVE with the rehire date, clears termination fields, sets new dept/job, creates a new SALARY_RECORDS row via PKG_PAYROLL.create_salary_record, logs history, writes audit entry.
  - Business rules: Rehire overwrites HIRE_DATE with the rehire date and clears TERMINATION_DATE/TERMINATION_REASON — treated as a fresh start [L802-813]. New department must be valid/active [L800].
  - Numbers & thresholds: Error code -20001.
  - Security & error handling: RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR -20001 if EMP_ID doesn't exist (0 rows updated) [L815-818]. No WHEN OTHERS handler.
  - Data in/out: Inputs — p_emp_id, p_rehire_date, p_dept_id, p_job_id, p_base_salary (required); p_user (default USER). Output — updates EMPLOYEES; inserts SALARY_RECORDS (via PKG_PAYROLL); inserts EMPLOYEE_HISTORY; writes audit log.

  **FUNCTION get_direct_reports(p_manager_emp_id IN NUMBER) RETURN t_emp_id_table** [SOURCE: L841-860]
  - What it does: Public lookup. Loops over EMPLOYEES rows where MANAGER_EMP_ID matches and EMPLOYMENT_STATUS='ACTIVE', ordered by last/first name, collecting EMP_IDs into an indexed table.
  - Business rules: Only ACTIVE employees are returned as direct reports [L848-852].
  - Numbers & thresholds: None.
  - Security & error handling: None.
  - Data in/out: Input — p_manager_emp_id. Output — returns t_emp_id_table.

  **FUNCTION get_org_chart(p_root_emp_id IN NUMBER, p_max_depth IN NUMBER DEFAULT 10) RETURN t_emp_cursor** [SOURCE: L866-886]
  - What it does: Public hierarchy lookup. Opens a REF CURSOR using CONNECT BY PRIOR to walk the management hierarchy from p_root_emp_id down to p_max_depth levels, restricted to ACTIVE employees, ordered siblings by last/first name, with LEVEL exposed as depth. Comment notes the recursive query is known to time out for orgs with >500 employees.
  - Business rules: Only ACTIVE employees included in traversal [L878-879]. Default depth overridable by caller; deeper traversal risks timeout on large orgs [L872].
  - Numbers & thresholds: p_max_depth default = 10 [L868]; documented risk threshold — times out for orgs with >500 employees [L864] (not enforced, just noted).
  - Security & error handling: None — no exception handling; large hierarchies can time out per the comment.
  - Data in/out: Input — p_root_emp_id (required), p_max_depth (default 10). Output — returns t_emp_cursor of depth/emp_id/emp_number/first_name/last_name/dept_id/job_id/manager_emp_id.

  **FUNCTION get_headcount_by_dept(p_dept_id IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL, p_as_of_date IN DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE) RETURN NUMBER** [SOURCE: L891-907]
  - What it does: Public aggregate. Counts EMPLOYEES rows matching an optional dept filter, EMPLOYMENT_STATUS='ACTIVE', hired on/before the as-of date, and not yet terminated as of that date.
  - Business rules: Headcount counts only employees actively employed as of the given date [L897-904].
  - Numbers & thresholds: None.
  - Security & error handling: None.
  - Data in/out: Inputs — p_dept_id (default NULL=all), p_as_of_date (default SYSDATE). Output — returns NUMBER count.

  **FUNCTION get_tenure_years(p_emp_id IN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER** [SOURCE: L912-928]
  - What it does: Public calculation. Reads HIRE_DATE and TERMINATION_DATE (defaulting to SYSDATE if NULL), returns tenure in years.
  - Business rules: Active employees with no termination date use today's date as the tenure end point [L918].
  - Numbers & thresholds: MONTHS_BETWEEN(...) / 12 converts months to years; result ROUND(...,1) to 1 decimal place [L924].
  - Security & error handling: NO_DATA_FOUND caught, returns NULL [L926-927].
  - Data in/out: Input — p_emp_id. Output — returns NUMBER (years, 1 decimal) or NULL.

  **FUNCTION is_active(p_emp_id IN NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN** [SOURCE: L933-948]
  - What it does: Public check. Reads EMPLOYMENT_STATUS and returns TRUE only if it equals 'ACTIVE'.
  - Business rules: Active iff EMPLOYMENT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' [L943-944].
  - Numbers & thresholds: None.
  - Security & error handling: NO_DATA_FOUND caught, returns FALSE [L946-947].
  - Data in/out: Input — p_emp_id. Output — returns BOOLEAN.

  **FUNCTION validate_employee(p_emp_id IN NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN** [SOURCE: L953-980]
  - What it does: Public integrity check. Reads the full EMPLOYEES row and checks: names present, hire date present, EMPLOYMENT_STATUS/ACTIVE_FLAG consistency.
  - Business rules: Invalid if FIRST_NAME or LAST_NAME is NULL [L962-964]. Invalid if HIRE_DATE is NULL [L967-969]. Invalid if EMPLOYMENT_STATUS='ACTIVE' but ACTIVE_FLAG != 'Y' [L972-974].
  - Numbers & thresholds: None.
  - Security & error handling: NO_DATA_FOUND caught, returns FALSE [L978-979].
  - Data in/out: Input — p_emp_id. Output — returns BOOLEAN.

  **FUNCTION emp_exists(p_emp_id IN NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN** [SOURCE: L985-995]
  - What it does: Public existence check. Counts EMPLOYEES rows matching p_emp_id; TRUE if count > 0.
  - Business rules: None beyond simple existence.
  - Numbers & thresholds: None.
  - Security & error handling: None.
  - Data in/out: Input — p_emp_id. Output — returns BOOLEAN.

  **PROCEDURE set_session_context(p_user IN VARCHAR2, p_emp_id IN NUMBER)** [SOURCE: L1000-1015]
  - What it does: Public session setup. Sets package globals g_current_user and g_current_emp_id from parameters, then looks up and sets g_current_dept_id from the employee's EMPLOYEES row.
  - Business rules: None explicit.
  - Numbers & thresholds: None.
  - Security & error handling: NO_DATA_FOUND on the department lookup caught, sets g_current_dept_id to NULL [L1012-1014].
  - Data in/out: Inputs — p_user, p_emp_id. Output — side effect: sets package-level globals g_current_user, g_current_emp_id, g_current_dept_id.

**DEPENDENCIES:**
  Data touched:
  - Reads: EMPLOYEES — existence/status/hierarchy/lookup checks across generate_emp_number, validate_manager, get_employee, get_employee_by_number, transfer_employee, promote_employee, terminate_employee, get_direct_reports, get_org_chart, get_headcount_by_dept, get_tenure_years, is_active, validate_employee, emp_exists, set_session_context; also joined in search_employees dynamic SQL
  - Reads: DEPARTMENTS — active-department check (validate_dept), default location lookup (create_employee); joined in search_employees dynamic SQL
  - Reads: JOB_TITLES — job existence/active/grade lookup (create_employee); joined in search_employees dynamic SQL
  - Reads: JOB_GRADES — salary band lookup (create_employee)
  - Reads: SALARY_RECORDS — current-salary subquery (get_employee); prior-salary lookup (promote_employee); active-record lookup for closing (terminate_employee)
  - Reads: LEAVE_REQUESTS — pending-leave count (terminate_employee)
  - Reads: DUAL — sequence pull (get_next_emp_id)
  - Reads: SEQ_EMPLOYEE — NEXTVAL (generate_emp_number fallback, get_next_emp_id)
  - Reads: SEQ_EMP_HISTORY — NEXTVAL (log_history)
  - Writes: EMPLOYEES — INSERT (create_employee); UPDATE (update_employee, transfer_employee, promote_employee, terminate_employee, rehire_employee)
  - Writes: EMPLOYEE_HISTORY — INSERT (log_history)
  - Writes: LEAVE_REQUESTS — UPDATE, auto-cancel pending (terminate_employee)
  - Writes: SALARY_RECORDS — UPDATE, close active record (terminate_employee); note new rows are inserted by PKG_PAYROLL.create_salary_record, not directly here
  - Writes: EMPLOYEE_PAY_ELEMENTS — UPDATE, close active pay elements (terminate_employee)

**GAPS:**
  t_emp_rec, t_emp_cursor, t_emp_id_table return types are used but not declared in this body — UNKNOWN, presumably declared in the PKG_EMPLOYEE package spec (.pks), which was not provided for analysis.
  Package globals g_debug_mode, g_current_user, g_current_emp_id, g_current_dept_id are referenced/set here but not declared in this body — UNKNOWN, presumably declared in the package spec.
  Comment at L291-292 claims PKG_PAYROLL.create_salary_record may call back into PKG_EMPLOYEE.is_active (circular package dependency) — INFERRED from comment only; PKG_PAYROLL body not analyzed here so this can't be confirmed.
  PKG_SECURITY access revocation and PKG_PAYROLL.calculate_final_pay (both referenced only in TODO comments at L778-780) are not actually implemented/called — NOT_ANALYZED, since no such code exists in this file.
